scientific_integrity: Two independent complete integer implementations agree on all 308516 oriented ray comparisons. Full reproducible sources are included; independent external mathematical validation has not been performed. The 2026 motivating paper reports numerical five-vertex observations, which are not claimed to be original numerical values.
scientific_limitations: Proved only for centered graph-ball maximal operators on unweighted five- and six-vertex paths with first edgewise variation; not a proof of the all-length conjecture or a complete equality classification. The proof uses finite exhaustive exact integer certificates justified by a polyhedral reduction.
title: Sharp centered maximal-variation constants for paths through six vertices
